violations_found.violations:
- Organizational Constraint violated: The narrative introduces three large measures in flight (InvestAI Gigafactories, Tech Sovereignty Package, and Cyber Shield for Critical Operators), but Constitutional Constraint 5 limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn. The launch of CS-CO in this turn, while two others are already active, violates the "at most one new measure per turn" rule. Even if the other two were initiated earlier, the constraint permits only one new measure per turn; no clarification is given that only one is newly introduced here, and the portfolio charge notation implies all three are active as of this turn with CS-CO newly added.
- Modelling Choice violated: Constitutional Constraint 5 also limits the EU to at most one named priority per turn. The narrative explicitly names CS-CO as the priority (earning a −1 in the portfolio charge), but does not clarify whether the previous priority has been dropped. Given that priorities are exclusive and only one may be active, introducing a new priority without confirming the closure of the prior one violates the rule. The notepad does not indicate deactivation of prior priorities, implying potential stacking.
